title: SPP1-CD44-Mediated Crosstalk Between Endothelial and Macrophage Subpopulations Promotes Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma Progression Through S100A6 Upregulation.
snippet: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) progression is driven by complex cellular interactions within the tumor microenvironment (TME), where endothelial cell (EC)-tumor-associated macrophage (TAM) crosstalk significantly influences angiogenesis and immune modulation, although the specific subsets and consequences remain unclear.
